simple.meaning: a tablet for writing (as bare ); by analogy, a mirror (as a plate )
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גִּלָּיוֹן (H1549) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גִּלָּיוֹן (gillâyôwn) means a tablet for writing (as bare ); by analogy, a mirror (as a plate ) First listed occurrence: Isa 3 23.

definitions.short: a tablet for writing (as bare ); by analogy, a mirror (as a plate )
definitions.full: H1549. gillayon גִּלָּיוֺן noun masculine table, tablet (Talmud גִּלְיוֺן , the empty margin of page or roll, see Lag GN 1881, 403 , compare BN 199) — עָלָיו וּכְתֹב גָּדוֺל גִּלָּיוֺן קַחלְֿךָ take thee a great tablet and write upon it Isa 8:1 ; plural הַגִּלְֹינִים tablets of polished metal, mirrors 3:23 ᵑ9 ᵑ7 Ges Che Di De; but transparent garments, gauzes , ᵐ5 Ew (compare Arabic fine garment ).
